Players Committee card image of [[Scarif: Landing Pad Nine (Docking Bay) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Your docking bay transit to or from here requires +1 Force (+4 Force if Shield Gate on table). '''Dark Side:''' Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your combat vehicles deploy +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/scariflandingpadnine_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
